facts.claim: Judging weighs real-world applicability, technical implementation, and demo clarity.

inference.rationale: Criteria emphasize working application footage and original architecture.

competition_research.sanitized_brief: Sample Civic Resilience Hackathon 2026. Tracks: Civic Data, Accessibility, Public Admin Tooling. Judging: technical implementation (high), real-world applicability (high), originality (medium), design/demo clarity (medium). Sponsor capabilities: managed DB, storage, serverless. Encourage open gov data. Blacklist: tutors, summarisers, wellness bots, opportunity navigators, crisis navigators, ops fatigue doctors. Prefer under-explored admin failure modes and allocation under constraint.

ideation.primary_user: Social-care caseworkers filing benefit appeal packs
ideation.painful_workflow: Reconstructing which form version, deadline clock, and evidence checklist applied on the decision date
ideation.current_workaround: Scattered PDFs, email threads, and tribal knowledge in WhatsApp groups
ideation.imported_mechanism: Configuration drift detection + temporal fault trees
ideation.core_computation: Diff official rule versions between decision date and today; emit missing-evidence set required for a valid appeal
ideation.last_mile_action: Generate a dated appeal checklist + filing calendar holds
ideation.visible_transformation: From 2 hours of version archaeology to a dated, auditable appeal pack outline in under a minute
ideation.why_now: Public guidance pages mutate silently; scrapable change histories make drift detectable
ideation.kill_reason: May require careful sourcing of archived guidance pages
ideation.killer_demo: Paste decision date + letter → show guidance diff → emit required evidence list with timestamps

ideation.primary_user: Borough planning officers prioritizing inspection slots
ideation.painful_workflow: Manually reordering inspection queues under statutory deadlines and staff sickness
ideation.current_workaround: Spreadsheet with colored cells and hallway negotiations
ideation.imported_mechanism: Constraint optimization with procedural fairness constraints
ideation.core_computation: Solve queue assignment optimizing overdue risk subject to fairness and skill constraints
ideation.last_mile_action: Publish next-day roster + citizen-facing delay notices draft
ideation.visible_transformation: Chaotic board → constraint-satisfying roster with overdue-risk score
ideation.why_now: Open planning datasets + cheap MILP/heuristic solvers
ideation.kill_reason: Solver demo may feel abstract without UX polish
ideation.killer_demo: Upload week's applications → show before/after overdue risk and fairness metric
ideation.hard_to_fake_advantage: Numeric optimization delta judges can recompute

ideation.primary_user: Council FOI officers before statutory breach
ideation.painful_workflow: Hunting which handoff stalled a request across teams
ideation.current_workaround: Email archaeology after the breach clock
ideation.core_computation: Infer most likely stalled edge in the process graph from timestamps
ideation.last_mile_action: Create escalation ticket with evidence timeline
ideation.visible_transformation: Blind inbox → pinpointed bottleneck + escalation draft
ideation.why_now: Case logs are exportable; graph reasoning is cheap
ideation.kill_reason: Needs a plausible synthetic log for demo
ideation.killer_demo: Show live clock near breach → highlight failing handoff → draft escalation
ideation.hard_to_fake_advantage: Stateful case timeline with computed bottleneck

ideation.primary_user: Charity finance officers reconciling restricted funds
ideation.painful_workflow: Matching spend lines to grant conditions before audit
ideation.core_computation: Score spend lines against encoded conditions; surface mismatched allocations
ideation.visible_transformation: Unscoped ledger → ranked exceptions with condition citations
ideation.why_now: Structured bank CSVs + better document parsing
ideation.killer_demo: Upload ledger + one grant PDF → red exceptions with citations

ideation.painful_workflow: Last-minute slot recovery when patients cancel
ideation.current_workaround: Phone blasting waiting list in arbitrary order
ideation.core_computation: Rank call order maximizing fill probability under notice-time constraints
ideation.last_mile_action: Generate ordered outreach list + SMS drafts
ideation.visible_transformation: Random calling → ranked recovery plan with expected fill lift
ideation.kill_reason: Health data sensitivity in live settings
ideation.killer_demo: Simulate 3 cancellations → show ranked backups and expected seats filled
ideation.hard_to_fake_advantage: Scored ordering with simulated fill lift

judge_technical.rationale: Clearest hard-to-fake computation with auditable trail

judge_product.rationale: Immediate workflow collapse for a constrained user

judge_sponsor.rationale: Stronger optional use of managed data store for state

judge_domain.rationale: Addresses a real administrative failure mode
